record.edic_text:
1882 epanorthosis {ep-an-or'-tho-sis}

from a compound of 1909 and 461; TDNT - 5:450,727; n f

AV - correction 1; 1

1) restoration to an upright or right state
2) correction, improvement of life or character

same.cexp: 恢復，重建；堅強起來；＜被＞直起來
正確地使用或解釋（#提後 2:15|）
對，正確地，合情合理地；清楚地
